Name: (CP) Elliott is Trash
Author: Mady0
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=5][b]Turn Elliott into a trash can.[/b][/size][/color]

This mod is for all Elliott haters. It turns Elliott into a trash can. Before he was practically trash, now he is trash.

This mod uses the various game trash cans sprites with some minor custom tweaks.

Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.

This has been updated for the 1.6 winter outfits.

Downloads.Description: Turns Elliott into a trash can, including during winter.
